meta.title: Nomad in Thailand Community - Meet Friends, Have Fun.
meta.desc: Join 'Nomad in Thailand', a community for digital nomads living in Thailand. Find friends through sauna, co-working, and casual meetups. Everyone is welcome!

hero.title:
No More Lonely
Nomad Life.
hero.subtitle:
Nomad in Thailand is a casual community
for digital nomads living in Thailand
to connect and share.

intro.title: Do you have these problems?
intro.p1: You finally got your freedom and came to Thailand, but it's surprisingly lonely...

problems.item1: Working alone all day, not speaking to anyone
problems.item2: No casual friends nearby to grab dinner with
problems.item3: Hard to get real, local information
problems.item4: Want to go to sauna or gym, but not alone

intro.solution:
Solve these problems with
Nomad in Thailand.

activities.title: Main Activities
activities.desc: In 'Nomad in Thailand', various club-like gatherings happen naturally within our LINE OpenChat. No obligation to join. Come when you want, stay casual.

sauna.title: Sauna & Ice Bath
sauna.desc: Touring sauna and ice bath facilities around Bangkok to share the 'Totono' experience.

muaythai.title: Muay Thai & Workout
muaythai.desc: Let's move our bodies. Gym sessions and running that even beginners can enjoy.

coworking.title: Co-working Sessions
coworking.desc: Our most popular event. Simply gathering at cafes or co-working spaces to focus on work.

party.title: Casual Drinks
party.desc: Quick drinks after work. A relaxed place for exchanging info and venting.

atmosphere.title: What's the vibe?
atmosphere.desc: We differ from 'hustle culture'. We respect each other's lifestyle with a mature sense of distance.

cta.title: Why not join us?
cta.desc:
Participation is free. You are welcome just to browse info.
Your life in Thailand will surely become more fun.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.a1: No, joining the community is completely free. You only pay for your own expenses (food, facility fees) when attending events.
faq.q2: Can I join if I'm still in Japan?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely! Many members use it to gather information before moving.
faq.q3: Is it okay for nomad beginners?
faq.a3: Of course. We have members with diverse backgrounds, including aspiring nomads and those who simply love Thailand.
faq.q4: Will I be solicited for anything?
faq.a4: Solicitation for network businesses, suspicious investments, or aggressive sales is prohibited. Admins will deal with it immediately if found, so please join with peace of mind.
